narrative: Liquidity is strong — LCR 193% and NSFR 127% [synthetic estimates] with a €1.8bn buffer. Aktia funds €7.9bn of lending with €4.1bn of deposits (45% of funding), covered bonds (28%) and senior debt (20%), so wholesale spreads go straight into NII. The €500M covered bond of September 2025 was more than twice oversubscribed and S&P's stable outlook supports 2027 pricing.

signals.title: CET1 12.6%, 4.0 points above the minimum
signals.excerpt: CET1 at the top of the 2–4 point target buffer over the 8.6% minimum requirement; S&P outlook raised to stable on 28 October 2026.

signals.title: FY2025: comparable operating profit €106.0M, CIR 59.0%
